sentences.text:
1. Allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2. Application accordingly disposed of.

3. The present Petition has been filed under Section 528, BNSS, 2023 for quashing of FIR No.
468/2014 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that essentially it was a property dispute as the Petitioner who are the Jeth and Jethani of Respondent No. 2 Ms. Neetu Nagpal and Petitioner No. 1 is the brother of respondent No.3.
5. The Will had been left in favour of the Petitioner No. 1 in respect of the Property and was challenged by respondent No. 3 and 4 in the Court.
The wife, in the interim got the FIR registered by roping in her husband as well as the two petitioners.
6. Thereafter, a Settlement was entered into between the parties before
